evals.prompt: Translate docs/architecture/README.md to English while preserving markdown structure and links.
evals.expected_output: A fully translated English markdown file with frontmatter, Mermaid diagrams, code fences, and relative links preserved.
assertions: Code fences (```) and inline code (`...`) remain untranslated
Relative markdown links and file paths are preserved verbatim
Mermaid flowchart node IDs and control flow remain intact
Prose and section headings are translated into English

evals.prompt: Batch translate all markdown files in docs/ to Portuguese and save them to docs/translations/pt.
evals.expected_output: Translated Portuguese markdown files saved in docs/translations/pt/ maintaining original directory hierarchy.
assertions: Script runs non-interactively and completes with exit code 0
Output directory docs/translations/pt contains corresponding .md files
Frontmatter keys (name, status, date) remain untranslated
